MODIFY src/commands/ship.ts. Route backend and model selection through `createAgentPortAdapter` instead of `getBackendSelector`. Tests: src/commands/ship.test.ts

REVIEW FAIL (code): Ship routing bypasses AgentPort — FR-001.
  WHERE: src/commands/ship.ts:784-810,867-920
  EXPECTED: Dry-run and execution call createAgentPortAdapter({ projectRoot: cwd }).selectRoute(...) for backend and model selection. Pass --agent as explicitBackend and resolve role-specific models for that backend.
  ACTUAL: Dry-run and execution call getBackendSelector(cwd).selectBackend(...). Dry-run with --agent prints the override without selecting a route. Execution calls resolveRegisteredRoute(...) separately for override and review models.
  FIX: Use AgentPort for both paths. Pass the selected implementation model and effort to shipPhase and resolve the review model and effort for the same backend.

REVIEW FAIL (code): Ship routing test exercises the old selector — FR-001.
  WHERE: src/commands/ship.test.ts:495-553
  EXPECTED: Assert AgentPort route selection in dry-run and execution. Cover explicit backend and configured model selection.
  ACTUAL: Tests mock ../server/index.js and assert calls to getBackendSelector().selectBackend() or expect --agent to skip it.
  FIX: Replace the server selector mock with an AgentPort test seam. Assert the dry-run route and the execution backend, model and effort with and without --agent.

REVIEW/GATE DIVERGENCE (T009, gate: gates/phase-02.sh, re-opened by review):
The review agent raised a finding on this task and its gate still passes, so the gate does not cover what review found. Add a test that fails on it, then fix, before completing.

DIAGNOSIS (iteration 2):
FIX: src/commands/ship.ts — Import `createAgentPortAdapter` from `../adapters/agents/index.js` and create it with `{ projectRoot: cwd }`. Call `selectRoute` with `type: "implement"` and `explicitBackend: opts.agent as string | undefined` in dry-run and execution. Print the selected backend, model and effort in dry-run. During execution, call `selectRoute` with `type: "review"` and `explicitBackend: implementation.backend`. Pass the implementation backend and model to `shipPhase` with `selectedEffort`, `reviewModel` and `reviewEffort` from the two routes. Remove the `getBackendSelector` and `resolveRegisteredRoute` imports.
FIX: src/commands/ship.test.ts — Replace the `../server/index.js` mock with a typed `selectRoute` mock returned by `createAgentPortAdapter` from `../adapters/agents/index.js`. Test dry-run and execution both with and without `--agent`. Assert `explicitBackend` and the configured implementation route in each case. Assert dry-run output and no dispatch. In execution, assert that the review route pins the implementation backend and that the mocked `ShipOrchestrator` receives `backend`, `selectedModel`, `selectedEffort`, `reviewModel` and `reviewEffort`.
FIX: specs/043-unified-routing-prompt-delivery/gates/phase-02.sh — Use the existing `src/commands/ship.test.ts` gate entry to verify the new route assertions fail before the ship change and pass afterward.
FIX: src/engine/model-routing.test.ts — Import `ModelSelector` and types `AgentBackendConfig` and `ModelEntry` from `../domain/agent-config.js`. Import `TaskClassification`, `classifyTask` and `TaskType` from `../domain/types.js`. In `src/server/backend-selector.test.ts` and `src/server/backend-selector.integration.test.ts`, import type `AgentRegistry` from `../domain/agent-config.js` and import `TaskClassification` and `TaskType` from `../domain/types.js`. Keep `BackendSelector` delegated to `selectAgentRoute`.
FIX: src/architecture.test.ts — Add an `inspectArchitectureSource` assertion for `src/engine/model-routing.test.ts`, `src/server/backend-selector.test.ts` and `src/server/backend-selector.integration.test.ts`. Resolve relative specifiers and reject dependencies on `src/server/agent-registry`, `src/server/model-selector` and `src/server/task-classifier` with or without `.js`. Verify failure before the import changes and success afterward through the existing phase gate.
FIX: src/server/quota-prober.ts — Use `import type { AgentBackendConfig, QuotaProbe } from "../domain/agent-config.js"`. Preserve quota probing behavior.
FIX: src/architecture.test.ts — Assert that `src/server/quota-prober.ts` has a type-only import from `../domain/agent-config.js` and no dependency on `./agent-registry` with or without `.js`. Verify failure before the import change and success afterward through the existing phase gate.
FIX: src/server/index.ts — Use `import { loadRegistry } from "../adapters/agents/registry-loader.js"` and `export { loadRegistry } from "../adapters/agents/registry-loader.js"`. Use the same import in `src/server/agent-registry.test.ts` and `src/server/agent-registry.integration.test.ts`. Retain `src/server/agent-registry.ts` through phase 02.
FIX: src/architecture.test.ts — Assert that `src/server/index.ts` imports and re-exports from `../adapters/agents/registry-loader.js` and that both registry suites import from it. Reject imports and re-exports from `./agent-registry` with or without `.js` in all three files. Verify failure before the loader changes and success afterward through the existing phase gate.

REVIEW FAIL (code): Ship bypasses configured quota routing — FR-001, unified routing.
  WHERE: src/commands/ship.ts:859-877, src/adapters/agents/index.ts:55-81,103-124
  EXPECTED: Pass configured QuotaProber readings and model cooldowns to selectAgentRoute. Preserve quota-based fallback and record the selected route for execution.
  ACTUAL: AgentPort supplies no quotas or cooldowns and accepts the provider checkQuota status. The fixture selects Codex at 0% cached quota over Claude at 90%. The previous selector picks Claude and records a routing decision. The migrated path records none.
  FIX: Supply the existing quota and cooldown facts through AgentPort and record the execution decision. Add a ship routing regression with a depleted preferred backend and an eligible fallback. Exercise the real adapter with fixture quota and database inputs.

REVIEW FAIL (code): Explicit ship dry-run creates the routing database — FR-001, unified routing.
  WHERE: src/commands/ship.ts:782-802, src/adapters/agents/index.ts:24-29,55-58
  EXPECTED: Resolve the explicit backend and its configured model in dry-run without creating or migrating a routing database.
  ACTUAL: The explicit preview calls selectRoute, which queries routing history before evaluating the override. The real adapter created a missing SQLite database in a temporary project.
  FIX: Resolve the explicit preview through AgentPort without opening a writable history store. Cover a dry-run with --agent and an absent database.

REVIEW FAIL (code): Ship pre-flight suite regresses after routing migration — FR-001, unified routing.
  WHERE: src/commands/ship-preflight.test.ts:21-28,128-169
  EXPECTED: The dry-run reports the fixture backend and the setup checks pass without running shipping effects.
  ACTUAL: The existing test expects gemini and now receives agy. The setup-complete case also reaches an unhandled SlackConfigSchema mock error. All five cases pass on the parent revision.
  FIX: Migrate the pre-flight fixtures to the AgentPort seam and isolate shipping effects. Add this suite to the phase gate.

REVIEW FAIL (code): Automatic ship routing ignores registry validation errors — FR-001, unified routing.
  WHERE: src/adapters/agents/index.ts:60-65,98-105,121-127; src/commands/ship.ts:861-869
  EXPECTED: Automatic ship routing rejects an invalid registry before selecting a backend. Preserve the validation error from tryLoadRegistry.
  ACTUAL: When agents.registry defines Codex with model codex-fast and agents.fallbackOrder is absent, the previous selector exits 1 with the missing-config error. AgentPort converts that error to an undefined registry, returns Codex with model default, and records quota_percent as null.
  FIX: Give the automatic ship route a registry-required policy through AgentPort. Propagate the loader error before installed-backend fallback. Add a ship integration test that omits agents.fallbackOrder and asserts exit 1 with no orchestrator construction or routing decision.

DIAGNOSIS (iteration 2):
FIX: src/adapters/agents/index.ts — In `selectAvailableRoute`, throw `new Error(registered.error.message, { cause: registered.error })` immediately after `tryLoadRegistry` when `context.requireRegistry && !registered.ok`. Add `requireRegistry?: boolean` to `RoutingContext` in `src/ports/agent-port.ts`. In `src/commands/ship.ts`, pass `requireRegistry: explicitBackend === undefined` to the execution loop’s implementation route and let `withSignal` report exit 1.
FIX: src/commands/ship-routing.integration.test.ts — Keep Codex available with model flag `codex-fast` and omit `agents.fallbackOrder` from the fixture. Run `createShipCommand().parseAsync` without `--agent`. Assert exit 1 and stderr containing `Missing required config: agents.registry or agents.fallbackOrder`. Assert no backend lookup, no `ShipOrchestrator` construction and no routing decision rows. Use the existing suite entry in `specs/043-unified-routing-prompt-delivery/gates/phase-02.sh` to verify failure before the fix and success afterward.

Verification: automatic preview rejects an invalid registry. Explicit backend selection bypasses automatic quota exclusion. The legacy script inherits its configured model on provider-default routes. The integration cases failed before the changes and pass in the phase gate.

REVIEW FAIL (code): Automatic ship routes ahead of quota ranking — FR-001, unified routing.
  WHERE: src/adapters/agents/index.ts:77-103,165-175 and src/commands/ship.ts:863-872
  EXPECTED: Automatic ship uses the quota-first ranking from BackendSelector.selectBackend. History breaks ties within the quota band. With Codex at 10 percent and Claude at 90 percent, select claude-primary.
  ACTUAL: The adapter passes agents.implement as pillarConfig and omits historyMode: "quota-tiebreak". The existing selector returned claude-primary in the same fixture where ship passed codex-primary to ShipOrchestrator.
  FIX: Pass the prior quota ranking and history facts to selectAgentRoute for automatic ship. Keep the role default out of that route's priority candidates. Add a gated case with both quotas positive and assert the chosen backend and model.

REVIEW FAIL (code): Native quota can veto an explicit ship backend — FR-001, unified routing.
  WHERE: src/adapters/agents/index.ts:165-193,217-221 and src/commands/ship.ts:783-790,869-872
  EXPECTED: An installed backend named by --agent stays pinned and proceeds with its configured models. The dispatch path handles provider rate limits.
  ACTUAL: The adapter omits cached quotas for explicitBackend but still requires quotaProbe(backend).status === "available". With an installed Codex backend returning rate-limited from checkQuota, ship --agent codex exited 1 before constructing ShipOrchestrator.
  FIX: Give the explicit ship route a backend override policy through AgentPort that bypasses quota eligibility. Add a gated case with isAvailable true and native checkQuota returning rate-limited. Assert both configured role models reach the orchestrator.

REVIEW FAIL (code): Review model selection rechecks the chosen backend's quota — FR-001, unified routing.
  WHERE: src/commands/ship.ts:869-895 and src/adapters/agents/index.ts:124-153,184-213
  EXPECTED: Once automatic ship selects a backend, resolve its configured review model through AgentPort and pass both role models to ShipOrchestrator without probing backend eligibility again.
  ACTUAL: The pinned review route performs quotaProbe again after recording the implementation route. A native check returning available for implementation and rate-limited for review made ship exit 1 before constructing ShipOrchestrator.
  FIX: Resolve the review model from the selected backend's registry facts through AgentPort. Reuse any model cooldown facts from implementation routing. Add a gated case that asserts one native eligibility check and verifies the orchestrator receives both models.

FIX: src/adapters/agents/index.ts — Retain the existing `RoutingContext.requireRegistry` check immediately after `tryLoadRegistry`. Preserve the loader message and cause before backend lookup. Retain the gated missing-`agents.fallbackOrder` cases that assert exit 1, the exact stderr message, zero backend lookups, zero orchestrator calls and zero routing decision rows.

FIX: src/adapters/agents/index.ts — Add `backendEligibility?: "quota" | "installed"` to `RoutingContext` in `src/ports/agent-port.ts`. In `src/commands/ship.ts`, set `"installed"` for `--agent` execution. Keep the backend pinned and require `getAgentBackend` plus `isAvailable()`. Skip `QuotaProber.probeQuota` and native `quotaProbe` for that policy. Keep model cooldown checks. Extend the explicit Codex integration case with `isAvailable()` returning `true` and `checkQuota()` returning `rate-limited`. Assert exit 0, zero `checkQuota` calls and one orchestrator call with `codex-primary` and `codex-review`.
FIX: src/commands/ship.ts — Request both models in the implementation call using `includeReviewModel?: boolean` on `RoutingContext`. Add `reviewModel?: string` and `reviewEffort?: string` to `SelectedAgentRoute` in `src/ports/agent-port.ts`. In `src/adapters/agents/index.ts`, resolve review with `selectAgentRoute({ type: "review" }, facts)` pinned to the accepted backend. Reuse the loaded registry and `cooledDownModels` without another backend lookup or quota probe. Return both models and pass them to `ShipOrchestrator`. Update `src/commands/ship.test.ts` to expect one routing call. In the integration suite, make Codex’s native check return `available` once and `rate-limited` thereafter. Assert exactly one check and one orchestrator call with both configured models and efforts.
FIX: specs/043-unified-routing-prompt-delivery/gates/phase-02.sh — Keep the existing `src/commands/ship-routing.integration.test.ts` entry. Run each new regression against the current router and confirm it fails on the reported behavior. Apply the fixes and rerun the full phase gate.

Verification: automatic routing reports quota exhaustion and preserves the three-backend attempt limit across model cooldown and native quota refusal. The phase gate reproduces both failures and passes after the repair.

REVIEW FAIL (code): Automatic ship accepts a missing backend executable — FR-001, unified routing.
  WHERE: src/adapters/agents/index.ts:212-223; src/engine/quota.ts:19-34; src/plugins/builtins/agents/codex/adapter.ts:31-44
  EXPECTED: Skip a backend whose isAvailable() returns false even if checkQuota() reports available. Select the next eligible backend within the three-attempt limit.
  ACTUAL: The automatic branch only checks quotaProbe(backend).status === "available". The built-in Codex quota stub returns available without checking the executable. With Codex at 100 percent and unavailable, and Claude at 50 percent and installed, ship passed codex-primary to ShipOrchestrator instead of claude-primary. The phase gate passed.
  FIX: Require executable availability as well as quota for automatic routes. Count an unavailable backend toward the existing attempt limit. Keep --agent quota bypass. Add this built-in adapter case to src/commands/ship-routing.integration.test.ts and assert Claude reaches ShipOrchestrator and the routing ledger.
